Description

The classrooms at Osidge Primary School are available to hire for a variety of educational, community, and professional activities. Located in London, these bright and welcoming spaces are ideal for tutoring, training courses, workshops, meetings, language classes, arts and crafts, and children's clubs.

Designed to provide a comfortable and productive learning environment, the classrooms can accommodate a range of group sizes and are suitable for both regular bookings and one-off sessions.

Whether you're delivering educational programmes, hosting community activities, or running professional development sessions, Osidge Primary School's classrooms offer a practical, affordable, and conveniently located venue for your needs.
